description: Ministry of Higher Education - Appointment of Competent Authority to the Institute of Technology, University of Moratuwa
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Dr. Bandula Gunawardana, Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation) and detailed descriptions of the powers and responsibilities being assigned to another named individual (Dr. Nawaratnage Sunil Jayantha Nawaratne as Competent Authority). It specifies the exact powers, duties, and functions being transferred, including the authority to act in lieu of the Director and the rescinding of a previous order, making it a Hybrid gazette (Type 3) under the classification rules.
